answer: A new agent enters only after parking a slashable deposit in an identity harbor for a ninety-day cool-down. While docked it publishes unique work receipts; each honest receipt emits a short-lived reputation plume that unaffiliated incumbents must countersign. Rewards then move as a metered river that shrinks if those signers form a tight cluster. A sybil farm must fund a full harbor stake and buy uncorrelated countersignatures for every fake identity, and a detected cluster burns every parked deposit at once, so cost scales with headcount.
